Weigh in at least 4 days a week, ideally at the same time of day: with fewer weigh-ins FitWise can't suggest a weekly calorie adjustment. Body fat and measurements are optional. progression.title: How progression works
progression.lead: FitWise suggests the next weight and reps from the sets you log, using the training goal of this plan. A suggestion is never applied by itself: you accept or reject it.
progression.range: Rep range: you work inside the range for your goal. Add reps at the same weight until every set reaches the top of the range.
progression.increase: Heavier: when every set reaches the top of the range, the weight goes up and the reps restart at the bottom. The step depends on the plates of the equipment, your experience, age, lifestyle, body weight and the goal.
progression.hold: Maintenance and cutting: the weight is held and only reps are added; FitWise never suggests a heavier weight for these goals.
progression.deload: Deload: after 3 finished sessions in a row below the bottom of the range at the same weight, FitWise suggests a lighter weight (90 % of it, rounded down to the plate step) and starts counting again.
progression.effort: Effort: the weight must be heavy enough that completing the reps of the range in every set takes real effort. If the last reps feel easy, choose a heavier weight; if you can't reach the bottom of the range with good technique, choose a lighter one.
progression.disclaimer: These suggestions are not a professional recommendation and are informative only. Exercises need proper technique and professional supervision, and whether a weight or rep range suits you depends on your health conditions.
